title: Cosine metric as a structural economic similarity measure
abstract: arXiv:2609.20424v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structural similarity, the extent to which economic mechanisms respond alike to common shocks, matters for economic forecasting, policy transfer, and other decisions that rely on evidence from comparable settings. For mechanisms approximated by linear models, this idea has a simple geometric representation: The smaller the angle between their coefficient vectors, the more similarly they respond to the same shock. This paper introduces the cosine of this angle as a measure of structural similarity and develops the corresponding inference procedure. Applied to New Jersey's wage mechanism around the 1992 minimum-wage reform, the approach yields interesting evidence: Although the reform clearly affected the low-wage part of the wage distribution, the underlying mechanism linking worker characteristics to wages was no different from what would have prevailed without it.

translated_title: 余弦度量作为结构性经济相似性度量
translated_abstract: 结构性相似性是指经济机制对共同冲击的响应程度相似，这对于经济预测、政策转移以及其他依赖可比环境证据的决策具有重要意义。对于用线性模型近似的机制而言，这一概念有一个简单的几何表示：系数向量之间的夹角越小，它们对同一冲击的响应就越相似。本文引入该夹角的余弦值作为结构性相似性的度量指标，并开发了相应的统计推断程序。将该方法应用于1992年最低工资改革前后新泽西州的工资机制，研究得出了有趣的证据：尽管改革明显影响了工资分布的低工资部分，但将工人特征与工资联系起来的潜在机制与没有改革时的情况并无不同。
tldr: 本文提出用线性模型系数向量夹角的余弦值作为结构性经济相似性的度量指标，并应用于1992年新泽西州最低工资改革，发现尽管改革改变了低工资部分的工资分布，但决定工资的底层机制本身并未发生变化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the cosine of the angle between linear model coefficient vectors as a measure of structural economic similarity, and its application to New Jersey's 1992 minimum-wage reform reveals that although the reform affected the low-wage portion of the wage distribution, the underlying wage-setting mechanism itself remained unchanged.
